set.body:
Epic: bd-01KX1P6Z3RW3T4GSZ4MT86Z7QQ

Move solver traits and result types for symmetric eigen, SVD, generalized eigen, SPD inverse, and related typed numeric capabilities into modules/linalg/shared. Keep Jacobi, QR, Cholesky, and Gram-SVD reference implementations portable for JVM and JS.
set.title: Linalg: extract portable solver algebra
